# LeonardoMD 0.3.1022 — Beta
- Help illustrations now use transparent Leonardo Classic artwork, with explanatory captions in Spanish and English. Updated main and agent-import guides create new personal copies while preserving your existing annotations. - Display math preserves Markdown-sensitive TeX and adjacent expressions, including the bilingual help regression examples. - The Mac can request a rubric capture from an explicitly compatible linked iOS device, review the returned image, and save or insert it into a document. - iOS capture requests require explicit consent and support preview, durable drafts and retry after interrupted transfers.
- Owner-only iOS distribution tooling prepares companion archives with branded icons and privacy metadata from clean source.
## Known limitations
- This macOS download supports Apple silicon. Compatible iOS companion distribution and physical-device capture acceptance remain separate from this release. - This beta has not been installed on the maintainer's Mac as part of publication; candidate-specific hosted update, installation and relaunch checks remain pending.

## Synchronization, organized by role
- Open **Preferences → Synchronization** for one shared Leonardo Sync control and two pages: **Share from this Mac** and **Connect to other computers**. - Manage shared content, invitations, device access and incoming reviews on the sharing page. Manage remote connections, synchronization intervals and offline copies on the connection page. - Device labels distinguish read-only clients, including Little Leonardo, from desktop Macs whose changes require review. Existing permissions and copies are preserved. - Turning Leonardo Sync off takes synchronization offline in both directions. Connecting to another Mac does not require sharing your own files.
## Updates from Preferences
Install and relaunch now closes Preferences automatically before the normal document checks. Cancelling keeps unsaved work; after saving, retry from Updates without quitting manually.
## Try it
Open **Preferences → Synchronization** and switch between both pages. Enable Leonardo Sync only when you want device synchronization; approve its background item in macOS if requested. Sharing selected saved files remains a separate choice.
Updated English and Spanish help explains both roles and safe update recovery.
This beta is for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. An older app still uses its old update implementation while installing this beta; if that first update stalls behind Preferences, close Preferences and quit normally once. Subsequent outgoing updates from this corrected version use the new flow. Save work before updating. Incoming edits continue to require explicit review.

## Clearer file selection and readable Leonardo filenames
The active file stays highlighted in the project explorer, including MDLF, MDLR and MDLZ, even when automatic following is turned off. Selection uses the system highlight with readable text and icons.
Leonardo filenames retain their wine color in light appearance and use a brighter tint in dark appearance. The English and Spanish guides explain selection and automatic following separately; existing personal guide copies remain intact.
This beta is for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Candidate-specific installed update and relaunch acceptance remains pending.
